description: Combine the cooperative two-CTA-per-matrix n=256 wavefront with the 32-wide strided-panel MathDx n=2048 winner. Keep separate 64-wide cooperative and 32-wide panel operators so symbol/workspace state cannot cross shape paths; preserve n=512, batched n=1024, direct n=4096, small, and large CuTe dispatches, then validate caches, caller-stream semantics, cleanup, and the full grid.

Kept the cooperative 64-wide two-CTA n256 operator unchanged and added an independently named 32-wide MathDx panel operator, dispatch state, grouped preparation, caller-stream panel updates, and cleanup for batch-8 n2048; full validation passed.
Added dedicated n2048 current-queue handle/object caching without sharing any n256 queue or dispatch state; validation passed and batch-8 n2048 measured 2507.670 us in the full grid.

Hoisted caller-queue lookup and immutable n2048 matrix/panel scalar construction out of the eight-panel launch loop; validation passed, full-grid score measured 946.174 us, and batch-8 n2048 measured 2516.819 us.

Returned to per-panel caller-queue verification and added a shape-reset, identity-checked hot-entry cache only for grouped n2048 outputs; validation passed, full-grid score measured 945.326 us, and batch-8 n2048 measured 2514.192 us.

Returned to the measured queue-cache path and set only the independent n2048 MathDx panel kernel to prefer L1; validation passed, full-grid score measured 942.649 us, and batch-8 n2048 improved to 2492.758 us.
Set only the independent n2048 MathDx panel kernel to prefer shared memory instead of L1; validation passed, full-grid score measured 952.493 us, and batch-8 n2048 measured 2575.282 us.

Restored the n2048 L1 preference and skipped the final panel update binding whose C++ body immediately returned; validation passed, full-grid score measured 951.699 us, and batch-8 n2048 measured 2543.972 us.

Returned to the n2048 L1 winner and replaced grouped triangular preparation with a contiguous full-matrix copy while retaining final upper cleanup; validation passed, full-grid score measured 955.968 us, and batch-8 n2048 measured 2523.074 us.

Added a dedicated caller-stream vectorized upper-triangle copy for grouped n2048 preparation while retaining final cleanup and the L1-preferred 32-wide operator; validation passed, full-grid score measured 942.743 us, and batch-8 n2048 improved to 2436.845 us.

Kept the vectorized grouped upper copy and replaced final triu cleanup with a dedicated caller-stream vectorized lower-zero kernel; validation passed, full-grid score improved to 939.239 us, and batch-8 n2048 improved to 2360.591 us.
Changed both grouped upper-copy and lower-zero kernels from 4096x256 to 8192x128 row grids; validation passed, full-grid score measured 941.664 us, and batch-8 n2048 measured 2370.930 us.

Isolated the grid sweep by using 8192x128 only for grouped upper-copy while restoring lower-zero to 4096x256; validation passed, full-grid score measured 947.220 us, and batch-8 n2048 measured 2394.167 us.

Completed the isolated grid sweep by restoring upper-copy to 4096x256 and using 8192x128 only for lower-zero; validation passed, full-grid score measured 946.544 us, and batch-8 n2048 measured 2393.541 us.
Completed the coarse memory-kernel grid sweep with 2048x256 for both grouped upper-copy and lower-zero; validation passed, full-grid score measured 947.171 us, and batch-8 n2048 measured 2415.985 us.

Combined isolated cooperative n256 and strided-panel n2048 MathDx paths across 14 validated trials. Best commit bfa1c27 measured 939.239 us versus the 960.686 us first parent; batch-8 n2048 measured 2360.591 us. Queue caching and L1 preference helped; shared preference, hot-entry/loop hoisting, final no-op skipping, full copy, and 2048/8192 grid variants measured slower. Local profiling was waived. Continue with lower-only grouped rank-k updates, fusing upper preparation into the first panel load, or fusing lower cleanup into the final panel store.

Combine the cooperative two-CTA-per-matrix n=256 wavefront with the 32-wide strided-panel MathDx n=2048 winner. Keep separate 64-wide cooperative and 32-wide panel operators so symbol/workspace state cannot cross shape paths; preserve n=512, batched n=1024, direct n=4096, small, and large CuTe dispatches, then validate caches, caller-stream semantics, cleanup, and the full grid.

Replaced the grouped n2048 full-square strided TF32 updates with caller-stream compact FP16 panel conversion and a single batch-aware CuTe 256x256 two-CTA lower-macrotile rank-k launch mapped onto physical upper storage; full validation passed, full-grid score measured 939.929 us, and batch-8 n2048 improved from 2360.591 to 2312.799 us.

Kept the final 256x256 grouped trailing update on strided TF32 GEMM because triangular CuTe saves no macrotiles there, while using CuTe for the six larger updates; validation passed, full-grid score measured 945.910 us, and batch-8 n2048 regressed to 2353.165 us versus 2312.799 us for all-CuTe.

Restored all seven triangular CuTe updates, zero-initialized grouped output pools once, and restricted recurring caller-stream cleanup to the lower halves of the eight 256x256 diagonal blocks that CuTe diagonal macrotiles can touch; validation passed, aggregate improved to 938.226 us, and batch-8 n2048 improved to 2303.304 us.

Removed standalone diagonal-block cleanup and zeroed only each 32x32 MathDx diagonal subtile below its diagonal; the standard validation grid passed, but the full benchmark target check failed lower-triangularity (relative residual 0.104) because transposed off-diagonal 32x32 tiles inside each 256x256 block were not cleared.

Completed cleanup fusion by zeroing each transposed physical-lower off-diagonal 32x32 tile while MathDx stored its physical-upper factor tile; validation and target correctness passed, but uncoalesced mirrored writes regressed aggregate to 944.151 us and batch-8 n2048 to 2432.072 us.

Made the fused physical-lower off-diagonal tile clears row-major and coalesced instead of exact-transpose scatter stores; validation and target correctness passed, recovering part of the prior penalty, but aggregate measured 945.170 us and batch-8 n2048 remained slower at 2357.513 us.

Restored the standalone diagonal-block cleanup winner and reduced its launch from 256 to 64 threads per block, matching the maximum 64 float4 stores in a 256-row tile; validation passed, but aggregate regressed to 946.194 us and batch-8 n2048 to 2351.628 us.

Restored 256-thread diagonal cleanup and changed grouped rank-k to the corrected one-CTA 128x128 topology with 148 persistent clusters; validation passed, but finer scheduling regressed aggregate to 948.738 us and batch-8 n2048 to 2369.776 us versus the two-CTA 256x256 winner.

Restored the two-CTA 256x256 winner and cached the compact-panel CuTe pointer, seven trailing-output pointers, and caller CUstream wrapper for grouped rank-k launches; validation passed, but full-grid score measured 946.709 us and batch-8 n2048 measured 2355.232 us, so Python launch-object caching did not improve the measured path.

Removed compact FP16 conversion and staging for grouped rank-k, feeding the physical-upper FP32 panel directly to a transposed-stride two-CTA CuTe TF32 update; validation passed, aggregate improved to 938.213 us, and batch-8 n2048 improved to 2264.704 us versus 2303.304 us for compact FP16 and 2360.591 us for full GEMM.

Removed grouped upper preparation by sourcing the first MathDx panel directly from input and using separate input-C/output-D tensors for the first direct CuTe update; the standard validation grid passed, but the exact batch-8 n2048 benchmark check failed reconstruction (relative residual 0.853), so the separate first-update path is invalid.

Repaired preparation elision by copying only the initial 256x1792 horizontal TRSM panel while sourcing the first diagonal block and trailing C directly from input; exact target correctness passed, but separate first-update C/D handling regressed aggregate to 947.357 us and batch-8 n2048 to 2341.097 us.

Restored full upper preparation and in-place direct FP32 C/D, then tested the corrected 256x128 two-CTA rectangular scheduler that doubles column work indices; validation passed, but aggregate measured 946.340 us and batch-8 n2048 2326.434 us, slower than the square 256x256 direct winner.

Completed resumed lower-triangular grouped n2048 search through trial 26. Best measured commit de082bd uses direct physical-upper FP32 panels with a batch-aware square 256x256 two-CTA CuTe TF32 rank-k and diagonal-block-only cleanup: full validation passed, aggregate improved to 938.213 us, and batch-8 n2048 improved to 2264.704 us (from 2360.591 us at the prior cleanup winner). Branch HEAD 2dff0e4 restores the exact de082bd tree. Compact FP16 reached 2303.304 us; final-panel GEMM, fused cleanup, 64-thread cleanup, one-CTA, cached launch objects, partial preparation, and rectangular scheduling measured slower. Preparation elision needs a kernel path that preserves in-place C/D efficiency while populating the first TRSM panel; separate first-update C/D was valid only after panel repair but slow. Local profiling remained waived because execution is Modal-remote and no Brev profiler URL is configured.
